questions.q: What is a Prince Rupert's drop and how is it made?
o: Molten glass quickly cooled in water
questions.e: In the video: "Pravi se tako što se istopljeno staklo brzo ohladi u vodi" — it's made by quickly cooling molten glass in water.

questions.q: Why wasn't the glass from a jar suitable?
questions.e: In the video: "staklo koje sam koristio da napravim ovu kapljicu nije adekvatno... nije čisto, već ima neke primese kako bi bilo jeftinije" — the glass I used to make this drop is not adequate... it's not pure but has some additives to make it cheaper.

questions.q: What did the author order for new attempts?
questions.e: In the video: "poručio laboratorijsko staklo, to su kao neki štapići koji se koriste za mešanje u hemijskoj laboratoriji." — I ordered laboratory glass, it's like little sticks used for stirring in a chemistry lab.

questions.q: How many successful drops did the author end up with?
questions.e: In the video: "dok nisam imao šest uspešnih celih kapljica" — until I had six successful whole drops.

questions.q: What did the drop withstand?
o: Pliers, a hammer blow and strong squeezing in a vise
questions.e: In the video: "Kapljica je izdržala klešta... preživela je i udarac čekićem" and "kapljica nije ni mrdnula" in the vise.

questions.q: What happened to the drop whose tail was cut off?
o: It didn't explode, but then it cracked and stopped being indestructible
questions.e: In the video: "iako nije eksplodirala sama od sebe prilikom presecanja repa, izgubila je svojstvo da bude neuništiva." — although it did not explode by itself when the tail was cut, it lost the property of being indestructible.

questions.q: Why is the drop strong at one end and brittle at the other?
o: The tail is made of a different glass
The outer layer cools and contracts faster, creating tension inside
There is air in the tail
questions.e: In the video: "spoljni sloj kapljice se naglo hladi i skuplja, dok unutrašnji deo ostaje tečan duže vreme. I zbog toga se u kapljici stvara napetost." — the outer layer of the drop cools and contracts suddenly, while the inner part stays liquid longer. And because of that tension forms in the drop.

questions.q: What did the super-slow-motion footage of a bullet hit show?
o: The head withstood the impact, then the tail vibrated and the drop cracked
questions.e: In the video: "Kada projektil udari kapljicu, ne dešava se ništa. Međutim, od udarca rep počne da vibrira. I tek tada primećujemo kako kapljica puca." — when the projectile hits the drop, nothing happens. However, from the impact the tail starts to vibrate. And only then do we see the drop shatter.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Pravi se tako što se *istopljeno* staklo brzo ohladi u vodi.
questions.e: Istopiti — to melt; istopljen — molten.

questions.q: Nosite naočare. I *rukavice*.
questions.e: Rukavice — gloves; ruka — a hand.

questions.q: Pa da probamo da je polomimo *kleštima*.
questions.e: Klešta — pliers, tongs. Kleštima — instrumental case: "with pliers".

questions.q: Ispada da sam *džabe* lomio onu teglicu.
questions.e: Džabe — colloquial for "in vain, for nothing".

questions.q: Kapljica je čvrsta na jednom kraju, a *krhka* na drugom.
questions.e: Krhak — brittle.

questions.q: U kapljici se stvara *napetost*.
questions.e: Napetost — tension; napeti — to stretch tight.

questions.q: Kada ovoj kapljici presečete *rep*, trebalo bi da eksplodira.
questions.e: Rep — a tail.

questions.q: Ovo je skoro *neuništiva* kapljica.
questions.e: Uništiti — to destroy; neuništiv — indestructible.

questions.q: Kada radite nešto sa ___, nemojte biti glupi.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa staklom.

questions.q: Staklo se topi na ___ od oko 1400 stepeni.
questions.e: Na in answer to "at what?" — locative case: na temperaturi.

questions.q: Kupio sam providnu ___ za vodu.
questions.e: Kupiti what — accusative case: posudu.

questions.q: Pucamo vazdušnom ___.
questions.e: The adjective vazdušnom is in the instrumental case, so the noun is too: puškom.

questions.q: Kapljica je izdržala ___.
questions.e: Izdržati what — accusative case; for klešta (neuter plural) it coincides with the nominative.

questions.q: Nemam hidrauličnu ___.
questions.e: Nemam + direct object: accusative case, presu.

questions.q: Dok nisam imao šest uspešnih celih ___.
questions.e: After numbers from 5 the genitive plural is used: kapljica.

questions.q: Sad čekamo da ti stakleni ___ stignu.
questions.e: The subject is in the plural, nominative case: štapići.
